cards.ex: My niece is a real digital native; she understands all the new apps instantly.
cards.exUz: Jiyanim haqiqiy raqamli tubjoy; u barcha yangi ilovalarni bir zumda tushunadi.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyalar bilan tug'ilgan va ularni yaxshi biladigan odam.

cards.ex: I control my home's lighting with a smart device connected to my phone.
cards.exUz: Men uyimdagi yoritgichni telefonimga ulangan aqlli qurilma orqali boshqaraman.
cards.uzDef: Internetga ulanadigan va turli vazifalarni bajaradigan qurilma.

cards.ex: Some analysts worry we're heading for another tech bubble like the dot-com era.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi tahlilchilar dot-com davridagidek yana bir texnologiya pufagiga qarab ketayotganimizdan xavotirda.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiya kompaniyalari qiymatining haddan tashqari oshirilishi.

cards.ex: This company is always ahead of the curve when it comes to developing new software.
cards.exUz: Bu kompaniya har doim yangi dasturiy ta'minot ishlab chiqishda trenddan oldinda.
cards.uzDef: Eng yangi texnologiyalarni birinchilardan bo'lib qabul qiluvchi.

cards.ex: My laptop's been on the fritz lately; I think I need a new one.
cards.exUz: So'nggi paytlarda noutbukim ishdan chiqyapti; menimcha, yangisini olishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Vaqti-vaqti bilan ishlamay qoladigan yoki nosoz.

cards.ex: They're using cutting-edge technology in their new research facility.
cards.exUz: Ular yangi tadqiqot markazida eng zamonaviy texnologiyalardan foydalanishyapti.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyaning eng rivojlangan va zamonaviy turi.

cards.ex: Closing the digital divide is crucial for ensuring equal opportunities for everyone.
cards.exUz: Raqamli tafovutni bartaraf etish har bir kishi uchun teng imkoniyatlarni ta'minlash uchun juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyalardan foydalanish imkoniyatidagi tengsizlik.

cards.ex: We've become so tech-dependent that we can barely function without our phones.
cards.exUz: Biz shunchalik texnologiyaga bog'liq bo'lib qoldikki, telefonlarimizsiz zo'rg'a ishlay olamiz.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyalarga juda katta darajada tayanadigan.

cards.ex: The internet went down for a few hours yesterday.
cards.exUz: Kecha internet bir necha soatga o'chib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Elektr toki o'chishi yoki server ishlamay qolishi.

cards.ex: Don't forget to plug in your phone before you go to bed.
cards.exUz: Uxlashdan oldin telefoningizni ulanishni unutmang.
cards.uzDef: Elektr manbaiga ulanmoq.

cards.ex: The developers released a bug fix for the app last night.
cards.exUz: Dasturchilar kecha ilova uchun xatoni tuzatishni chiqardilar.
cards.uzDef: Dasturiy ta'minotdagi xatoni bartaraf etish.

cards.ex: Video streaming can be a real bandwidth hog, slowing down everyone else's internet.
cards.exUz: Video oqimi haqiqiy keng polosali xaridor bo'lishi mumkin va boshqalarning internetini sekinlashtirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Keng polosali internetni ko'p sarflaydigan dastur yoki foydalanuvchi.

cards.ex: There's a growing techlash against big tech companies and their influence.
cards.exUz: Katta texnologiya kompaniyalari va ularning ta'siriga qarshi o'sib borayotgan texnologiya tanqidi mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiya sanoatiga qarshi keskin salbiy reaktsiya.

cards.ex: He decided to go dark on social media for a while to focus on his mental health.
cards.exUz: U ruhiy salomatligiga e'tibor qaratish uchun bir muddat ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda o'chirishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Onlayn mavjudlikni to'xtatmoq yoki aloqani uzmoq.

cards.ex: Many companies partner with social media influencers to promote their products.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina kompaniyalar o'z mahsulotlarini targ'ib qilish uchun ijtimoiy tarmoq ta'sirchilari bilan hamkorlik qiladilar.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda katta ta'sirga ega bo'lgan shaxs.

cards.ex: I'm planning a digital detox weekend to escape the constant notifications.
cards.exUz: Men doimiy bildirishnomalardan qochish uchun raqamli detoks dam olish kunlarini rejalashtiryapman.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiya qurilmalaridan qisqa muddatga voz kechish.

cards.ex: Cybersecurity is a growing concern for businesses of all sizes.
cards.exUz: Kiberxavfsizlik barcha o'lchamdagi korxonalar uchun o'sib borayotgan muammo hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Kompyuter tizimlari va tarmoqlarini himoya qilish.

cards.ex: I took a crash course in web design last summer.
cards.exUz: O'tgan yozda veb-dizayn bo'yicha tezlashtirilgan kurs oldim.
cards.uzDef: Tez va intensiv tarzda o'tiladigan kurs.

cards.ex: This new technology is a real game changer for the industry.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi texnologiya sanoat uchun haqiqiy o'yinni o'zgartiruvchi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni tubdan o'zgartiradigan narsa.

cards.ex: My brother is a real tech geek; he knows everything about computers.
cards.exUz: Ukam haqiqiy texnika ishqibozi; u kompyuterlar haqida hamma narsani biladi.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyaga qiziqishi yuqori bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: We live in a wired world where everyone is constantly connected.
cards.exUz: Biz hamma doimiy ravishda bog'langan simli dunyoda yashaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyalar bilan bog'liq va ularga qaram.

cards.ex: She's a power user of Excel; she can do anything with spreadsheets.
cards.exUz: U Excelning tajribali foydalanuvchisi; u jadval bilan hamma narsani qila oladi.
cards.uzDef: Dastur yoki tizimdan unumli foydalanuvchi.

cards.ex: Developers use a sandbox to test new code before releasing it to the public.
cards.exUz: Dasturchilar yangi kodni ommaga chiqarishdan oldin sinov muhitida sinab ko'rishadi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfsiz sinovlar uchun ajratilgan dasturiy muhit.

cards.ex: I'll ping the server to see if it's still online.
cards.exUz: Server onlayn ekanligini tekshirish uchun ping qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Tarmoqqa aloqa borligini tekshirish buyrug'i.

cards.ex: We use end-to-end encryption to protect our users' privacy.
cards.exUz: Biz foydalanuvchilarimizning maxfiyligini himoya qilish uchun oxirdan oxirigacha shifrlashdan foydalanamiz.
cards.uzDef: Xabarlarni faqat yuboruvchi va qabul qiluvchi o'qiy oladigan shifrlash.

cards.ex: Tech giants like Apple and Google have a huge impact on our lives.
cards.exUz: Apple va Google kabi texnologiya gigantlari hayotimizga katta ta'sir ko'rsatadi.
cards.uzDef: Yirik va nufuzli texnologiya kompaniyasi.

cards.ex: The company's website was hacked last week.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning veb-sayti o'tgan hafta xakerlik hujumiga uchradi.
cards.uzDef: Kompyuter tizimlariga ruxsatsiz kirishga urinuvchi shaxs.

cards.ex: Artificial intelligence is transforming many industries.
cards.exUz: Sun'iy intellekt ko'plab sanoatlarni o'zgartirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Mashinalarning inson aqlini taqlid qilish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: Smartwatches are a popular type of wearable device.
cards.exUz: Aqlli soatlar taqiladigan qurilmalarning mashhur turidir.
cards.uzDef: Kiyish mumkin bo'lgan elektron qurilma.

cards.ex: The TV's been on the blink all day.
cards.exUz: Televizor butun kun davomida nosoz bo'lib turibdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqti-vaqti bilan to'g'ri ishlamaydigan.
